question: The rice sold by a grocer contained 20% of low-quality rice. What quantity of goodquality rice should be added to 175 kg of mixed rice so that the percentage of lowquality rice remains 10%?

**Given:**

The rice sold by a grocer contained 20% of low-quality rice. What quantity of good quality rice should be added to 175 kg of mixed rice so that the percentage of low-quality rice remains 10%?

Total weight of rice after adding good quality rice = 175 + x

Percentage of low-quality rice after adding good quality rice = 10%

Initial low-quality rice = 20% of 175 kg = 0.2 × 175

After adding good quality rice, the low-quality rice should be 10% of (175 + x)

**Calculations:**

0.2 × 175 = 0.1 × (175 + x)

⇒ 35 = 0.1 × (175 + x)

⇒ 35 = 17.5 + 0.1x

⇒ 35 - 17.5 = 0.1x

⇒ 17.5 = 0.1x

⇒ x = 175

**∴ The correct answer is option (1).**
